verdict.rationale: Folk is a CRM with a public REST API, webhooks and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test-mode API keys, or an isolated non-production workspace. The quick-start and API docs only describe operating directly on the live workspace.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
